content.short: SentismAI is an AI agent layer for Web3 gaming and decentralized automation.
content.description: SentismAI embeds intelligent agents to enrich game economies, enable autonomous gameplay, and support vibrant digital ecosystems within Web3. Its core capabilities revolve around AI-powered gaming agents that automate resource farming, questing, and economy management, along with personal agents designed for players and developers. The platform features self-learning, interoperable AI built for Web3 environments, governed by decentralized, on-chain decision-making.
